scene.zh: 粉色樱花暴风雪，狂风将花瓣卷成粉色风暴
scene.en: pink cherry blossom blizzard, strong wind whipping petals into a pink storm

scene.zh: 日出时的日柱，朝阳上方垂直的光束
scene.en: sun pillars at sunrise, vertical beams of light above the rising sun

scene.zh: 火山闪电，火山灰烟柱中迸发的电光
scene.en: volcanic lightning, bolts of electricity within the ash plume of an eruption

scene.zh: 冻雾，微小的冰晶悬浮在空气中，一切覆上白霜
scene.en: frozen fog, tiny ice crystals suspended in air, everything coated in white frost

scene.zh: 层积云毯下的平静海面，柔和的灰与银
scene.en: a calm sea under a blanket of stratocumulus clouds, soft gray and silver

scene.zh: 乳状云，袋状云从天空垂下，不祥之美
scene.en: mammatus clouds, pouch-like formations hanging from the sky, ominous beauty

scene.zh: 沙尘暴后的日落，天空透过来渐散的沙尘发出深橙色光
scene.en: sunset after a sandstorm, the sky glowing deep orange through the departing dust

scene.zh: 翻滚的雾堤如一堵白墙向乡野推进
scene.en: rolling fog bank advancing like a white wall over the countryside

scene.zh: 火彩虹环地平线弧，高卷云中的彩色光谱
scene.en: fire rainbow circumhorizontal arc, a spectrum of colors in high cirrus clouds

scene.zh: 霰粒软冰雹坠落，白色小颗粒在地面上弹跳
scene.en: graupel soft hail falling, tiny white pellets bouncing on the ground

scene.zh: 夜间光柱，城市灯光在冰晶中向上反射
scene.en: light pillars at night, city lights reflecting upward in ice crystals

scene.zh: 山巅下的云海，如白色棉花的海洋
scene.en: a sea of clouds below a mountain peak, like an ocean of white cotton

scene.zh: 雪旋风，小龙卷风般的雪在冰湖上旋转
scene.en: snow devils, tiny tornadoes of snow spinning across a frozen lake

scene.zh: 飓风之眼，晴空被云墙包围，诡异的平静
scene.en: eye of the hurricane, clear blue sky surrounded by a wall of clouds, eerie calm

scene.zh: 雷暴云上方的红色精灵闪电，高层大气水母状放电现象
scene.en: red sprite lightning above thunderclouds, jellyfish-like electrical phenomena in the upper atmosphere

scene.zh: 远处火山的火山灰降落，灰色雪覆一切，末日寂静
scene.en: ash fall from a distant volcano, gray snow covering everything, apocalyptic silence

scene.zh: 高山辉，山谷已暗时山顶被染成粉红色的日落
scene.en: alpenglow, mountains turning pink and red at sunset when the valley is already dark

scene.zh: 维纳斯带，暮光时地平线上方的粉色带，地球的影子升起
scene.en: belt of venus, pink band above the horizon at twilight, earth's shadow rising

scene.zh: 横跨整个天穹的巨型彩虹，双弧带附属弓
scene.en: gigantic rainbow spanning the entire visible sky, double arc with supernumerary bows

scene.zh: 下坡风冲下冰川，冷空气可见流动，冰晶飞散
scene.en: katabatic wind racing down a glacier, cold air visibly streaming, ice crystals airborne

scene.zh: 雨幡，雨落下但在触及地面前蒸发，幽灵般的条带
scene.en: virga, rain falling but evaporating before reaching the ground, ghost-like streaks

scene.zh: 山谷云逆温，云海在下，山峰如岛屿在上方
scene.en: cloud inversion in a valley, sea of clouds below, mountain peaks like islands above

scene.zh: 幻日，太阳两侧的亮点，冰晶晕
scene.en: sundog parhelion, bright spots on either side of the sun, ice crystal halo
